title: Holmium Laser vs Bipolar Enucleation of a Large Volume BPH: a Randomised Controlled Study
brief_summary: To compare bipolar plasmakinetic enucleation versus holmium laser enucleation for management of large BPH.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients suffering from LUTS secondary to infravesical obstruction from BPH
* failed medical treatment
* International Prostate Symptom Score (IPSS) \> 13
* a peak urinary flow rate (Qmax) \< 15 ml/sec
* a prostate size ≥ 80 gm

Exclusion Criteria:

* presence of a urethral stricture
* neurological disorder
* bladder cancer
* prostate cancer
* previous history of bladder neck surgery or TURP
